messages:
Sam (devex): FYI after releasing 0.4.0 a few onboarding samples started failing in edge runtimes. Cloudflare/wrangler report 'No matching export' for subpath imports like `@redwood/inference-sdk/edge`. Repro and notes below.

Leah (eng-runtime): ouch. can you paste the published package.json exports and the exact import path used by the samples?

Sam (devex): consumers do `import { createClient } from '@redwood/inference-sdk/edge'`. Pulled the package.json that went to npm: 
```
{
  "name": "@redwood/inference-sdk",
  "version": "0.4.0",
  "main": "dist/index.cjs.js",
  "module": "dist/index.mjs",
  "types": "dist/index.d.ts",
  "exports": {
    "./package.json": "./package.json",
    "./node": "./dist/node.cjs.js",
    "./edge": "./dist/edge.mjs"
  }
}
```
Cloudflare worker error: `Error: No matching export in '.../node_modules/@redwood/inference-sdk/package.json' for './edge'`. VSCode/tsserver also no longer resolves `@redwood/inference-sdk/edge` typings.

Marcus (eng-ml): wildcard -> explicit subpath exports can break both editors and strict ESM loaders. TypeScript needs either an explicit d.ts subpath or typesVersions so `@redwood/inference-sdk/edge` maps to a declaration file. Some bundlers/edge loaders are strict about conditional objects too.

Ava (devex): quick mitigations: a) add small root proxy files `edge.mjs` and `edge.cjs.js` that re-export the dist build so older loaders/bundlers find a file without depending solely on exports map; b) update `exports` to use condition objects for import/require/default and include a wildcard fallback; c) publish `dist/edge.d.ts` and add types mapping for the subpath. Also add a short onboarding note about subpath imports and typings.

Leah (eng-runtime): agree. recommended exports shape to reduce ambiguity: 
```
"exports": {
  "./package.json": "./package.json",
  "./node": { "require": "./dist/node.cjs.js", "import": "./dist/node.mjs" },
  "./edge": { "import": "./dist/edge.mjs", "default": "./dist/edge.cjs.js" },
  "./*": "./dist/*.js"
}
```
and add `typesVersions` or `"./edge": "./dist/edge.d.ts"` in exports so TS resolves the subpath. order of conditional keys matters for some bundlers.

Sam (devex): opened a small PR with proxy files + exports/types update + a tiny npm-pack resolution smoke test that runs Node ESM and a wrangler-like import check. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1429

CI-bot: sample-apps/edge job failed on main — import-resolution-error related to sdk@0.4.0.

Ava (devex): once PR is green publish a 0.4.1-canary and run the onboarding matrix (Next/Vercel/Bun/Wrangler). add a short migration note in the onboarding README and ping customers who reported issues.

Leah (eng-runtime): long-term: add a release CI step that npm-packs and verifies subpath resolution across Node/Bun/Cloudflare. assigning follow-up to eng-runtime.

Sam (devex): update: PR passed, canary published, verified sample apps on Cloudflare and Vercel edge. monitoring errors for 48h. :thumbsup:
